text: of good family, these two are the practices of the bodhisattva mahāsattvas. Moreover, son of good family, the bodhisattva mahāsattvas have two practices. What are the two? Namely: the practice of abandoning the faults of the stages, and the practice of perfecting skill in advancing from stage to stage. Son of good family, these two are the practices of the bodhisattva mahāsattvas. Moreover, son of good family, the bodhisattva mahāsattvas have two practices. What are the two? Namely: the practice of [unclear] of the śrāvakas and pratyekabuddhas, and the practice of skill in being irreversible from the awakening of a buddha. Son of good family, these two are the practices of the bodhisattva mahāsattvas. Son of good family, the practices of the bodhisattva mahāsattvas are these, of this kind, and in them the bodhisattva mahāsattvas should strive. Son of good family, for the bodhisattva mahāsattvas who practice in this way, unsurpassed, perfect and complete awakening is not difficult to attain.
